panel.camera: Standing eye height on the road-facing side of the axis, looking across the drain toward the vending bay and frontage; 40mm waist-up two-shot, medium depth.
panel.background: The real maroon three-wheeler and raised serving hatch occupy frame left behind Kasun, with the blue awning above left. The pale boundary wall and recessed shutters extend across frame right; the clay tea flask stands on the right end of the vehicle's stainless serving ledge at lower left.
panel.picture: The red mannequin stands left with chest facing screen right, and the blue mannequin stands right with chest facing screen left; both have their feet planted on their fixed concrete landing spots below the crop. Red's far-side right hand extends the clay phone into the centre, while blue's near-side right palm waits separately beneath it and both heads tip toward the object. Red's near-side left hand hangs empty beside the left hip. Blue's far-side left hand grips the clay umbrella shaft at upper-chest height, with its canopy above frame right and the clay handbag hanging by its handles from the same left forearm, partly visible at lower right.
